name: @researchos/ui-research-writing
description: Phase 4 ui-research-writing (v0.1): out-of-tree client package — a conversation chat node triggered by a user message keyword (写作/改写/润色/翻译/writing/polish...) that renders a writing panel (text + action + instruction) calling /research-writing/rewrite and showing the result. Text and action are prefilled from the triggering message.
